resources.string: Highlight real controls with automatic text wrapping, theme colors and optional motion. The guide preserves the host window and system bars.
Follow each tip to explore the controls.\nSkip anytime and come back later.
Skip or use system Back to leave this guide.

This longer introduction checks automatic line wrapping and explicit paragraph breaks. The card is measured against the current window, including visible system bars, display cutouts and the keyboard.

With larger fonts or a smaller window, the description can scroll while the action buttons remain available. Rotate or resize the window to check that the highlight follows its target.

A deliberately long identifier also needs to wrap: ExampleIdentifierWithoutSpaces0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ.

The guide never changes fullscreen mode or system bar icon colors. Those remain the responsibility of the host application.

You can skip or return at any point. Reopening the guide resolves the actual target again.
